comparison.objective: Fit a long wardrobe rail into closed and open end supports under geometric constraints; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part insertion and swing/tilt reorientation versus fine coaxial tool seating and jam-nut locking.
comparison.success_condition: Both rail ends seated, level, still, and released versus accurate locked opening with low drift after three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual, but their tested geometries, force interactions, and terminal outcomes differ.
